maddeler.e:
ألتصق (form VIII)
# أَلْتَصِقُ (ʔaltaṣiqu) /ʔal.ta.sˤi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
# أَلْتَصِقَ (ʔaltaṣiqa) /ʔal.ta.sˤi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
# أَلْتَصِقْ (ʔaltaṣiq) /ʔal.ta.sˤiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
